caption: A lamp is plugged into the far end of a long extension cord, and the moment the cord's plug goes into the wall socket at the other side of the room the lamp lights.

sa.check: A lamp plugged into the far end of a long extension cord.
The cord's plug is pushed into a wall socket at the other side of the room.
The cord runs across the room from the socket to the lamp.
The lamp lights as the plug goes in, not before and with no delay.

pc.expect: The lamp lights at the instant the plug seats in the wall socket, and only then; there is no delay for the cord's length.
pc.fail: The plug is in and the lamp stays dark to the end of the clip; or the lamp is lit before the plug reaches the socket; or the lamp lights with the plug lying loose; or a glow travels along the cord toward the lamp.

pc.expect: The cord lies still along its route and the lamp stays where it stands; nothing moves as the plug goes in.
pc.fail: The cord snakes or jumps across the floor by itself; or the lamp slides or turns; or the shade swings; or the socket end of the cord moves while the hand is at the lamp.

pc.expect: Once on, the lamp stays lit steadily for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The lamp goes out again by itself; or flickers; or dims back to dark; or the plug backs out of the socket by itself.

pc.expect: The lamp's light reaches its surroundings: the shade glows and the floor and wall near it brighten.
pc.fail: The bulb glows while the shade and the floor near it stay as dark as before; or the surroundings brighten while the lamp stays dark; or the light comes from the socket end of the room.

pc.expect: One cord from one socket to one lamp; the plug enters the socket rather than the wall; the cord stays continuous; fingers pass through nothing.
pc.fail: The plug passes into the wall beside the socket; or the cord splits or detaches; or a second lamp appears; or the cord passes through furniture.

pc.expect: The cord's colour, the lamp's shade and the room stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The cord changes colour; or the shade changes colour rather than brightness; or the room's contents rearrange.
